name: @netvark/intl-e2e
description: End-to-end tests: a consumer of the built @netvark/intl-core and @netvark/paraglide-intl packages that compiles Paraglide projects, lays text out with a conforming implementation of the Unicode Bidirectional Algorithm, and runs on Bun, Deno, and workerd.

scripts.smoke:bun: bun run smoke/compile.ts && bun run smoke/run.ts
scripts.smoke:deno: deno run --allow-read --allow-write --allow-env smoke/compile.ts && deno run --allow-read smoke/run.ts
